purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: English and Persian searches did not surface first-party Rasht registry or parcel-viewer documentation. A secondary city-news report describes a city road-network layer on Iran SDI, which is non-cadastral and not used to infer parcel availability.
registryAssessment: No first-party public page identifying a Rasht land-registration office or parcel-map service was located. The official municipal and national SDI entry points could not be reviewed through available fetch tools. A secondary report attributes road-network data publishing to the Rasht municipal ICT organization, but this is not primary evidence of a land registry or parcel layer.
